title: Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear
arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ
latin: Lā yukallifullāhu nafsan illā wus'ahā, lahā mā kasabat wa 'alaihā maktasabat
translation: Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned.
lesson: This verse is a personal anchor during hardship. It reframes difficulty not as punishment, but as a measure tailored to my capacity. Every trial comes with the strength to bear it.
reflection: When overwhelmed, remember that Allah measured this burden for you specifically. You are more capable than you think.
